test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We are __discussing for__ the same matter.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **'discussing'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence "We are discussing for the same matter" uses an unnecessary preposition **'for'.**
 
• The verb 'discuss' typically stands on its own without needing any preposition.
